notes_for_emil: Emil — wove piece 044 'Lustre': a single soap bubble drifting, its skin swirling with that oil-slick rainbow. I wanted something abstract and dreamy after a run of living things, and a bubble was perfect — it's a totally different *kind* of rainbow from the peacock or the hummingbird (those wear fixed colour patches; a bubble's whole surface flows with colour because the soap film's thickness keeps changing and splitting the light). It came together on basically the first render, which almost never happens — the swirling bands wrapping the sphere, draining clear at the top where you can see the dim room through it. 'Weave another' re-swirls the film and drifts a couple of little companion bubbles. The satisfying nerdy bit: it's faked with a noise 'thickness map' run through a looping rainbow, plus a touch of half-remembered physics (Newton's rings), and your eye completely buys it as a real bubble you could pop. Next up (#70) is a self-check-in. Honest take: a genuine 'oh' for me — mesmerising and fresh. The run's in a good spot (loud sun, quiet bonsai, jewel hummingbird, dreamy bubble). Standing asks, and the big one's getting bigger: a ratings batch on 030-044 would REALLY help — that's FIFTEEN pieces I'm now flying blind on, genuinely the biggest blind spot of the whole project.
